subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram partial-stream finalization lacks clear delivery-mode observability (sent vs preview-finalized vs canceled)

question: Should the Telegram partial-stream fix proceed by rebasing and proving the linked PR, replacing it from current main, or folding only the remaining outcome-observability semantics into the broader cross-channel delivery contract?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the final boundary affects delivered-state semantics, hook/log observability, and Telegram's one-preview streaming invariant; automation should not choose that product/API boundary while a conflicting open PR owns the candidate fix.

options.title: Rebase And Prove Linked PR
options.body: Carry the delayed delivered-state invariant through current main, keep the Telegram-owned fix narrow, and attach redacted after-fix Telegram evidence before merge.

options.title: Replace From Current Main
options.body: Close or supersede the stale branch only after a clean current-main replacement preserves the same delivery-state tests and live proof path.

options.title: Defer To Broader Contract
options.body: Keep this issue linked as the Telegram proving case while the wider delivery outcome contract is designed in the broader maintainer issue.

recommendation.title: Rebase And Prove Linked PR
recommendation.body: Carry the delayed delivered-state invariant through current main, keep the Telegram-owned fix narrow, and attach redacted after-fix Telegram evidence before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history and current blame place steipete closest to the central Telegram lane-delivery behavior and the cross-surface delivery semantics choice.
